intro: Honduras has about 10 million people, most of them young.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are mestizo. The Garífuna, of mixed African and Indigenous descent, live on the Caribbean coast. Spanish is official.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Tegucigalpa is the capital; San Pedro Sula is the business centre.

keyTerms.meaning: An Afro-Indigenous people of the Caribbean coast.
